hypotheses.null_hypothesis: The full DhakaNest method has no positive mean paired NDCG@10 difference relative to each prespecified principal baseline.
hypotheses.alternative_hypothesis: The full DhakaNest method has a positive mean paired NDCG@10 difference relative to the prespecified principal baselines.
hypotheses.statistical_test: paired permutation tests with profile-level bootstrap confidence intervals and Holm adjustment
hypotheses.interpretation: Positive adjusted evidence supports improved relevance; failure to reject is inconclusive and does not establish equivalence.

hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Destination-aware routing, importance, and commute constraints do not improve mean paired NDCG@10 over their prespecified destination-reduced controls.
hypotheses.alternative_hypothesis: At least one prespecified destination-aware comparison produces a positive mean paired NDCG@10 difference while maintaining reported constraint satisfaction and coverage.
hypotheses.unit_of_analysis: tenant profile with valid frozen routes
hypotheses.statistical_test: paired permutation tests with Holm adjustment plus destination-count interaction estimates
hypotheses.interpretation: Report relevance, commute satisfaction, and empty-result tradeoffs together; a null result is not proof that destinations are irrelevant.

hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Destination-first and area-first workflows have the same distribution of independently assessed selected-property relevance after accounting for participant and task effects.
hypotheses.alternative_hypothesis: Destination-first discovery improves independently assessed selected-property relevance after accounting for participant and task effects.
hypotheses.statistical_test: mixed-effects ordinal model with participant and task effects; paired sensitivity analysis
hypotheses.interpretation: Objective relevance is primary; perception measures are supporting and cannot substitute for it.

hypotheses.null_hypothesis: KNN shortlist selection does not change mean paired NDCG@10 relative to ranking all eligible commute-complete candidates with WSM.
hypotheses.alternative_hypothesis: KNN shortlist selection changes mean paired NDCG@10 and/or computational cost relative to ranking all eligible candidates.
hypotheses.statistical_test: two-sided paired permutation test with bootstrap confidence interval
hypotheses.interpretation: Quality and efficiency effects must be reported separately; a non-significant quality difference is not equivalence.

hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Five-criterion WSM reranking does not improve mean paired NDCG@10 over KNN similarity ordering.
hypotheses.alternative_hypothesis: Five-criterion WSM reranking improves mean paired NDCG@10 over KNN similarity ordering.
hypotheses.statistical_test: one-sided paired permutation test with bootstrap confidence interval
hypotheses.interpretation: Evidence concerns reranking within the same shortlist and does not isolate individual WSM criteria.

hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Removing Rent Fairness and renormalizing the remaining WSM weights does not change mean paired NDCG@10.
hypotheses.alternative_hypothesis: Including Rent Fairness improves mean paired NDCG@10 over the prespecified no-fairness ablation.
hypotheses.unit_of_analysis: tenant profile with complete stored rent assessments
hypotheses.statistical_test: one-sided paired permutation test with bootstrap confidence interval
hypotheses.interpretation: Rent Fairness means model-based rent reasonableness, not demographic or societal fairness.

hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Recommendation overlap under each prespecified realistic perturbation is no greater than the protocol's chance reference distribution.
hypotheses.alternative_hypothesis: Recommendation overlap under prespecified perturbations exceeds the chance reference distribution while relevance and coverage changes remain quantified.
hypotheses.statistical_test: profile-level bootstrap confidence intervals and comparison with a seeded random-ranking reference distribution
hypotheses.interpretation: High stability can preserve either good or poor rankings, so overlap must be reported with NDCG and constraint outcomes.

hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Expected absolute XGBoost test error is equal across prespecified rent, size, and geographic groups.
hypotheses.alternative_hypothesis: Expected absolute XGBoost test error differs across at least one prespecified group.
hypotheses.statistical_test: bootstrap subgroup contrasts with family-wise multiplicity control; omnibus permutation test where sample sizes permit
hypotheses.interpretation: Heterogeneity identifies reliability limits; failure to reject does not prove equal subgroup performance or market calibration.
